title: James May Tests Tesla's Grok-Powered AI Voice Assistant
description: Former Top Gear host James May has tested Tesla's Grok-powered AI voice assistant, Ara, describing it as slightly odd, insincere, and phony according to recent reports.

sections.heading: Testing the Assistant
paragraphs: According to Yahoo Autos and Benzinga, former 'Top Gear' host James May tested Tesla's Grok-powered AI voice assistant, known as Ara.

sections.heading: Reactions and Criticism
paragraphs: Yahoo Autos and Benzinga report that May characterized the interaction with the AI as 'slightly odd.' Furthermore, eciks.org states that May criticized the voice assistant for being 'insincere and phony.'
